description: This file defines a service class 'LocationService' in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing location-related operations such as retrieving, searching, saving, and deleting location data. It interacts with Data Access Objects (DAOs) and uses traits for additional functionalities.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Service class providing location management functionalities, including retrieve, search, save, and delete operations, leveraging DAOs and traits for extended features.

methods.name: getLocationDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LocationDao object.

methods.name: setLocationDao
methods.description: Setter method for injecting a LocationDao instance.

methods.name: getLocationById
methods.description: Retrieves a Location entity by its ID.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations matching the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching search criteria.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Returns total employees count in a specific location.

methods.name: getLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Fetches location IDs for an array of employee numbers.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of locations accessible to a specific employee, considering role permissions.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves a Location entity to the database.

methods.name: getLocationsArray
methods.description: Retrieves all locations and normalizes them into the LocationModel array.
